domains.title: Domains or URLs
domains.description: Websites to check. Bare domains (allbirds.com) or full URLs (https://www.allbirds.com/pages/about). Duplicates are removed. We read the page you give (the homepage for a bare domain).

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many sites to check at the same time.

timeoutSecs.title: Timeout per site (seconds)
timeoutSecs.description: Give up on a site after this many seconds. Timed-out sites are returned free with status "error".

includeAllTechnologies.title: Include full technologies list
includeAllTechnologies.description: Include every detected technology with categories, version and confidence. Turn off to get only the summary fields (platform, cms, hosting, cdn...).
